title: It's a Race, Not a Vlog!  A Day in the Life of a Chinese University Student
description:
Huge thanks to my amazing roommate Luna for filming all the dorm segments! 📸 It’s hard to believe she was working at a snack shop just a year ago. We worked so hard to get into the same university and ended up as besties and roommates. If you're curious about Luna's "Day in the Life" as a part-timer, check out this video:
Luna’s Snack Shop Job: https://youtu.be/1cUq7BujJgI
